caseName: Dickey's Barbecue Rests., Inc. v. Chorley Enters., Inc.
caseNameFull: DICKEY'S BARBECUE RESTAURANTS, INC. v. CHORLEY ENTERPRISES, INC.

opinions.text: Motion of International Franchise Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Atlantic Legal Foundation, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied.
